name: Checking or interlocking relay
summary: Checks a required equipment state before the operating sequence proceeds.
description: Checks a required equipment state before the operating sequence proceeds.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the equipment status contacts used as permissives. The associated drawing should trace the blocked or permitted command path; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the equipment status contacts used as permissives.

drawingChecklist: Label the equipment status contacts used as permissives.

distinction: An interlock verifies a condition; a time delay by itself does not prove that condition.
